short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 552 recent saved-signal files and 83 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around bakigul (@bakigulai) on X and @zarazhangrui: A great way to learn design: Give Codex a well-designed website, ask it to..., plus 7 more. A source image from github.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from bakigul (@bakigulai) on X.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-12. Use diagrammatic fold with overhead scan; make A large white negative-space field holds most of the plate, echoing the sparse widescreen UI-cover crop of the anchor image. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central black angular paper wedge, upper-left torn convergence, and top-right folded white-black plaque.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
